title: NOPD - Home
key_finding: NOPD is an official City of New Orleans department and describes itself as the city's police department.

title: NOPD - About - Police Districts
key_finding: The city says New Orleans is divided into eight NOPD police districts, confirming a real citywide primary policing surface.

title: Electronic Police Report 2024
key_finding: The city publishes 2024 NOPD incident-report data, showing that local current-year police-report publication continued even though the repo's federal summary row collapsed to zero.

title: Electronic Police Report 2023
key_finding: The city also publishes the prior-year NOPD incident-report dataset, supporting a continuing local publication program rather than a one-off 2024 surface.

title: NOPD Annual Preliminary Crime Statistics: 2024 Compared to 2023
key_finding: NOPD publishes a 2024 annual preliminary citywide major-offense summary with a total of 16,622 versus 22,376 in 2023, which materially undercuts the repo's current all-fill 2024 target.

title: NOPD Special Victims Division 2024 Annual Summary
key_finding: NOPD publishes a separate 2024 UCR rape count of 708 and explains that its UCR rape classification includes all Louisiana rape definitions plus subsets of sexual battery and indecent-behavior incidents.

title: Crime in Louisiana 2023
publisher: Louisiana Commission on Law Enforcement and Louisiana Sheriff's Association
key_finding: Louisiana's current public annual report path is continuity-oriented and lagged; it confirms New Orleans P.D. as a real Louisiana reporting entity but does not provide a ready 2024 city-level replacement workbook.
